title: @ycforge/js-dev-tools — IAM token resolution contract (spec 023)
description: Machine-readable contract for resolveIamToken (spec 023, S-8, FR-023..025, D-7). Priority chain env → OAuth (~/.yc/config.yaml) → SA key (~/.yc/keys/*), first success wins. Fail-open: any unresolvable step yields undefined + a reason code; the local server keeps running without a token (warning JDT_IAM_UNAVAILABLE, once per start). No refresh/retry in v1 (A-8/A-9). IamTokenExchanger is injection-seam for tests (mocked; tests never talk to Yandex Cloud).

resolveIamTokenOptions.title: ResolveIamTokenOptions
resolveIamTokenOptions.description: Test/override seams. Public default resolution uses the real home dir, the Yandex Cloud IAM endpoint and the global fetch.

homeDir.description: Baseline of ~/.yc lookups (tests: temp dir). Default os.homedir().

iamEndpoint.description: IAM API base, default https://iam.api.cloud.yandex.net. Exchange calls POST {iamEndpoint}/iam/v1/tokens.

fetchImpl.description: Injected fetch implementation; default globalThis.fetch. All network calls go through it (mocked in tests).

iamUnavailableReason.title: IamUnavailableReason
iamUnavailableReason.description: Fail-open reason for the JDT_IAM_UNAVAILABLE warning (FR-024, FR-029). One per failed resolution.

enumDescriptions.no-credential: No YC_IAM_TOKEN env, config.yaml missing/without token, and no parseable ~/.yc/keys/*.json.
enumDescriptions.io: Config/keys directory read or YAML/JSON parse failure.
enumDescriptions.exchange-error: IAM API returned non-2xx or a malformed response (including rejected OAuth token).
enumDescriptions.network-error: fetch threw (DNS/TCP/TLS). No retry in v1.

resolutionResult.title: ResolutionResult
resolutionResult.description: Internal detailed result (used by the server banner). Public resolveIamToken returns the token only.

token.description: Resolved IAM token; present on success, absent on failure.

reason.description: Present on failure (banner/log); absent on success.

chain.title: Resolution chain (S-8, FR-023)
chain.description: Strict priority; the first successful step is final (US3-SC...4).

step1Env.description: Non-empty env value returned as-is. NO network calls on this path (US3-SC1).

format.description: Yandex Cloud CLI format: { current: <profile>, profiles: { <name>: { token, cloud-id, folder-id } } }. Active profile token read; t1.-prefixed value treated as an already-IAM token and returned as-is; otherwise exchanged as OAuth.

keyJson.description: Service-account key JSON: id, service_account_id, key_algorithm (RSA_2048), private_key (PEM with literal \n), public_key.

jwt.description: Header { alg: "PS256", typ: "JWT" }; claims { iss: service_account_id, aud: "{iamEndpoint}/iam/v1/tokens", iat: now, exp: now + 3600 }; signed via node:crypto RSA-PSS-SHA256 (RSA_2048 key).

pooling.const: one resolution per server start; no TTL refresh in v1 (rotation by restart)
